row.evidence: Rubrik's public RSC GraphQL reference documents user management (createUser, deleteUsersFromAccount, updateRoleAssignments, addIdentityProvider) but no SCIM, and its product documentation requires a login, so SCIM support and plan cannot be determined publicly.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only: no public price list, and www.rubrik.com refused curl, WebFetch and the headless renderer (403 / ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES). Product docs (docs.rubrik.com) require a Rubrik login, so rule 5 'none by absence' cannot be applied. The public developer portal's GraphQL schema has no SCIM operations; it does expose user CRUD, role assignment, SSO identity providers and SSO-group role mapping, and an audit-event query. The Okta OIN 'Rubrik Security Cloud' app is an API integration for backing up Okta, not SSO/provisioning into Rubrik.

scim.notes: Not determinable from public sources. Rubrik's product documentation (docs.rubrik.com) requires a login and www.rubrik.com refuses automated fetches. The public RSC GraphQL schema index (1,006 mutations, 1,159 queries, 7,837 types) contains no SCIM operation or type; the only Okta OIN app is an API service integration for backing up Okta, not SSO or provisioning.

auth.notes: Service accounts (client ID + secret) obtain a bearer token from /api/client_token; RBAC roles on the service account limit access. Token lifetime configurable up to 24 hours (example 43200 s).

capabilities.notes: Deactivate/reactivate here means admin lock/unlock of user accounts. Group management means assigning roles to SSO (IdP) groups via inviteSsoGroup.

endpoints.purpose: List users with roles, groups, lockout and MFA state
Create a user with email and role IDs
Replace role assignments for users and/or groups
Revoke all org roles from users and groups
Assign roles to an SSO group

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event webhooks exist for workload/audit events; user-lifecycle event types not confirmed.

rate_limits.text: HTTP 429 on exceeding the rate limit; guidance is to stay under 50 requests per second.

user_api.notes: Rubrik Security Cloud (RSC) GraphQL API. Plan gating is not documented publicly (quote-only vendor). A beta Task-Based REST API covers workloads only.

okta.notes: The only OIN listing ('Rubrik Security Cloud') has just 'API' checked: an API service integration that lets Rubrik back up and restore the Okta tenant. SAML, OIDC, SWA and SCIM are unchecked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Entra Learn tutorial found (rubrik-tutorial, rubrik-security-cloud-tutorial, rubrik-provisioning-tutorial all 404).

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector pages block bots; no public Rubrik OneLogin guide.

fallbacks.notes: RSC supports external SSO identity providers (addIdentityProvider) and role assignment to SSO groups (inviteSsoGroup), which suggests group-based access at SSO sign-in, but JIT behaviour is not documented publicly. Product docs require a login.
